name: hybrid-ev-mode
$comment: EV launch: MG2 alone accelerates the Prius from rest with 150 N*m while MG1 holds the engine at rest. Generated by design/build_model.py; see the README.

annotations.text: **Planetary set (bond graph).** The 0-junction `Mesh` carries the tooth-normalised mesh force F. Its flow balance is the Willis equation (Zs+Zr) w_carrier = Zs w_sun + Zr w_ring; the TFs (moduli in teeth) give the torque split T_sun : T_ring : T_carrier = Zs : Zr : (Zs+Zr) = 30 : 78 : 108.

**Trip computer.** Integrals of the fuel rate (kg), the speed (m), the firing flag (engine on-time, s) and the powers (J); L100km/y = fuel / distance / density x 1e5; RegenShare/y = 1 - friction brake energy / braking energy demand.
**EV launch.** A step of the tractive force demand (MG2 150 N*m at the ring); the engine is off: the energy manager is replaced by constants (on = 0, speed reference 0).

**Plant (bond graph).** Engine (MSe = throttle x WOT(w), plus the unfired drag MSe) on its inertia, the input damper (C, R) onto the carrier; the planetary set (subsystem); MG1 on the sun, MG2 on the ring: inverter MTF from the DC bus, stator R (copper loss) and L, EMConverter, iron loss R; spin losses on the ring; ring -> final drive TF -> half shafts (C, R) -> wheel (friction brake MR) -> tyre -> vehicle mass I with drag MR, rolling resistance MSe and grade Se. Battery (Thevenin, OCV table), DC-link C and the auxiliary load R on the bus.

parameters.name: m_veh
parameters.description: Vehicle mass with driver (Prius NHW20 curb 1310 kg + 75 kg)

parameters.name: m_rot
parameters.description: Equivalent mass of the four wheels' inertia, 4 J_w / r^2

parameters.name: J_ring
parameters.description: Ring gear and counter drive gear inertia

parameters.name: J_mg2
parameters.description: MG2 rotor inertia (ORNL rotor mass 10.2 kg)

parameters.name: P_aux
parameters.description: 12 V auxiliary load through the DC/DC converter (assumed)

parameters.name: interp_ocv0
parameters.description: Open-circuit voltage at soc0 (the DC-link start voltage)

options.text: MG2 alone pulls away with **150 N*m**; MG1 turns backwards (w_sun = -2.6 w_ring) and holds the engine at rest. Change the mass or the grade and re-run.
